topic: Há negros na Argentina? Geledés Brasil
insights: Afro-descendants in Argentina represent a small percentage of the population, with the 2010 census recognizing around 150,000 Afro-Argentines.
Historical policies of whitening and the impact of wars led to a significant decline in the Afro-Argentine population, which was once a substantial part of the demographic.
Studies suggest that between 4% and 6% of the Argentine population may have African ancestry, despite the visible absence of Afro-descendants in many societal sectors.
The celebration of San Baltasar is one of the few remaining cultural events maintained by Afro-descendants in Argentina.
The 2022 census indicated an increase in the Afro-Argentine population to approximately 302,936, or 0.66% of the total population.

summary: Argentina has a small but significant Afro-descendant population, historically marginalized and often overlooked in national narratives. Recent census data indicates a gradual recognition of this community, though many still face systemic invisibility and challenges in representation.
